homePage.seoText:
NKN Atelier is the design studio of Nataliia Khreshkova, working for Hamburg and northern Germany. It is bespoke tailoring where fit comes first: made-to-measure garments, one-of-one pieces, small series, original fabric prints and the upcycling of clothes you already own. Every piece is constructed rather than merely sewn, drawing on 37 years of pattern-making and handcraft.

The route to a finished garment is always the same: a conversation about the occasion, the material and the silhouette, then measurements, pattern construction, intermediate fittings and final production. If you cannot come in person, the whole process runs online — guided measuring over video, remote material selection and shipping across Germany and beyond.

The atelier sits in Kaltenkirchen, roughly 35 minutes from Hamburg, and serves clients in Hamburg, Norderstedt, Quickborn, Elmshorn, Bad Segeberg, Neumünster and across Schleswig-Holstein. Alongside made-to-measure work it offers style and image consulting, capsule wardrobe planning, and pattern making and samples for emerging fashion brands. Consultations in German, English and Russian.

upcycling.seoText: Upcycling at NKN Atelier (Hamburg) is not “repair” — it is an artistic transformation of garments from your wardrobe. We analyse fabric and construction, propose a new silhouette and function, and preserve what is valuable in the original piece. The result is a contemporary garment with a new story, made with professional finishing. Suitable for coats, blazers, dresses, shirts and more.

01.question: How does the process start?
01.answer: We begin with a consultation where you show me the garment and describe your vision. I analyze the piece, assess its potential, and suggest transformation options. Then we discuss the concept and agree on the direction.

02.question: How long does upcycling take?
02.answer: Typically 2-4 weeks, depending on the complexity. Simple reconstructions take less time, while complete transformations with new construction require more work. I will give you a timeline after our initial consultation.

03.question: Is it possible to fully change the garment?
03.answer: Yes. Upcycling can range from subtle updates to complete reconstruction. I can change the silhouette, add or remove elements, combine multiple pieces, or create something entirely new while respecting the original fabric and history.

04.question: Do you work with both women's and men's clothing?
04.answer: Yes, I work with every kind of garment, whether or not it was originally cut as menswear or womenswear. What matters is the quality of the fabric, its structural potential, and your vision for the transformation.

05.question: What if the fabric is damaged?
05.answer: Damaged areas can often be worked into the new design, or removed during reconstruction. Sometimes the wear itself becomes part of the story. I assess the condition during the consultation and suggest the best approach.

01.question: Where is the atelier located?
01.answer: The atelier is based in Hamburg (Germany). I take bespoke clients in person at the Hamburg studio and also work online with clients from other German cities and other countries.

02.question: How long does made-to-measure tailoring take?
02.answer: It depends on the model and its complexity — typically 2 to 8 weeks from the moment the design is agreed. Tight deadlines, such as a wedding or a shoot, we discuss in the consultation.

03.question: What kind of clothing do you make?
03.answer: Dresses, women's and men's suits, jackets, coats, trousers, waistcoats, shirts, corsets, bridal and evening looks, capsule collections.

04.question: Is online tailoring possible without visiting Hamburg?
04.answer: Yes. There is a full online format: video consultation, detailed instructions for taking measurements, remote approval of construction and fabrics. The finished piece is shipped within Germany and worldwide.

05.question: How much does bespoke tailoring cost?
05.answer: The price depends on the model, the construction, the fabric and the number of fittings. In a free 30-minute consultation we go through the project and agree on the quote before any work starts.

06.question: Do you speak Russian and German?
06.answer: Yes, consultations and work are possible in Russian, German or English — whichever feels easier for you.

dataProcessing.title: 3. Data processed and purposes
dataProcessing.content:
I process personal data solely within my professional activity as a fashion designer, style consultant and provider of bespoke tailoring.

a) Contact and scheduling
Collected when you contact me via Instagram, WhatsApp, Facebook, TikTok, Telegram or email.
Processed data:
• Name or username
• Phone number
• Email address
• Message contents
• Appointment details (place, time)
• Information about wishes, style questions, physical specifics
Legal basis:
Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR (pre-contractual steps, contract performance)
Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (legitimate interest in efficient communication)

b) Personal 1:1 consultation – on-site or with me
Processed data:
• Body measurements (e.g., bust, waist, hips, arm length, back length)
• Necessary fit measurements using a tape measure
• Photos of clothing and silhouette (if voluntarily provided)
• Style preferences, materials, colors, wishes
• Figure specifics (e.g., posture, proportions, individual fit requirements)
Note:
Physical contact during measuring (placing a tape measure) serves purely technical purposes and is not data processing itself. Only the measurement results are processed.
Legal basis:
Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR

c) Bespoke tailoring and garment design
Processed data:
• Measurements and fit data
• Technical sketches
• Fabric and design selection
• Photos for fit analysis (if voluntarily provided)
Legal basis:
Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR

d) Payments
Processed data (depending on payment method):
• Name
• Bank details (IBAN)
• PayPal name/email
Legal basis:
Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR
Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR (tax retention obligations)
